about: I am a recent B.Tech graduate in Information Technology with a strong foundation in programming and a passion for building impactful web applications. Through internships and college projects, I developed hands-on experience in full-stack development and enjoy turning complex problems into simple, intuitive solutions. My final-year project was an AI-powered interview preparation platform built with Flask and SQLite. I am continuously improving my skills in programming languages like Python and SQL along with web technologies such as HTML and CSS. Driven by curiosity, I aspire to grow as a professional developer and contribute meaningfully to the tech community.
